title: Choose a message
summary: Fortran: Choose a message. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: An if block runs one branch based on a logical test. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Choose a message
blocks.code:
program lesson
  implicit none
integer :: score = 8
if (score >= 5) then
 write(*,'(A)') "Pass"
else
 write(*,'(A)') "Try again"
end if
end program lesson

blocks.text: The score is at least 5, so the then branch runs.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Close the block with end if.
